'''Operation Starbird''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operation to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jered Pole]], the Alliance inserted several operatives onto the planet disguised as [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]], businessmen and entrepreneurs in order to report on the ongoing operations on the planet. During the operation, the Rebel operatives exposed the local resistance movement [[J'Mer Sab|Night Wind]] as an Imperial-controlled organization.<ref name="GSotE" />
